_meta.role: Software & Hardware General Interest - Algorithm Engineer

summary: Recent M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY. Build and validate signal processing and machine learning algorithms in Python and PyTorch, from a custom wavelet denoising bank for microscopic crack inspection to a from-scratch mel-spectrogram ASR pipeline at 15% WER. Experience spans medical imaging segmentation on multi-modal MRI, deep learning model optimization, and algorithm deployment to production edge devices.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Trained U-Net segmentation with VGG-16, VGG-19, and ResNet-50 backbones on multi-modal MRI; validated on Dice Score and IoU and reported accuracy-latency trade-offs for deployment.
Engineered a custom data pipeline for the BraTS 2020 multi-modal MRI dataset with medical imaging augmentation and batch-loading memory management for large-scale 3D volumetric inputs.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Designed a custom wavelet bank (alpha-blended sym6+bior3.5) to suppress low-frequency noise; combined with optimized homography stitching and concurrency to achieve a PSNR of 86.
Deployed ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation for crack-depth profiling with +/-8% error on 3D surface reconstruction, completing a full metal surface inspection pipeline.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT, an OCR-free document understanding transformer, on a custom medical billing dataset for structured field extraction; improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93%.
Built preprocessing and training pipelines in PyTorch using the HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoder API with domain-specific special tokens and a resized decoder embedding layer.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 annotated images achieving 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation; exported to ONNX and TFLite for on-device mobile deployment.

projects.name: Whisper-Style ASR from Scratch
bullets: Built an end-to-end speech recognition pipeline from first principles: 80-channel mel spectrogram encoder and 4-block causal Transformer decoder with cross-attention, achieving 15% WER on the NPTEL 2020 Indian-English dataset.
Designed a custom BPE tokenizer with a Cython-accelerated backend achieving 4-5.5x speedup over pure Python, processing 6M characters in 15 minutes.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) - MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Integrated faster-whisper speech recognition (1.0-1.4s), Gemini intent classification (<500ms), and TensorRT-optimized YOLO (5.2x speedup: 56.7 to 10.9 ms) for visual servoing across a three-layer distributed pipeline.

Handled production deployment of the Jetson-side inference bridge as a systemd service with auto-restart backoff, non-root isolation, and static IP networking; achieved 100% pick reliability over 10 trials.
